<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Regulatory impact on capital markets:</strong> SEBI’s overhaul of the Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) framework and SME IPO norms has triggered volatility in exchange and brokerage stocks, forcing investors to reassess the impact of new settlement and disclosure mandates.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>RBI liquidity and policy outlook:</strong> With forex reserves at $691.1 billion, the RBI’s ongoing defense of the rupee is tightening domestic liquidity and pushing bond yields higher, while reports suggest the central bank may consider an unscheduled rate hike to combat persistent inflation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNRUxiUEJFbllqd0Y3RGdsRy1XNXNwazBZSHo0ZDJ5VmtEc25vWURRUWszUUJRbnNfdC0wOTZrSlhwODd6Zlpfb2pqekt2VVJkM3llNnE1MHRRTV9KcVNNdHNPX3FFNE1QazVUdkwtU2RsY0JtcTRjQ21PSFE3UGZlcjFTcnphMGMyUFdYUUVTTnlSQlFVeFFTemE3TWtDTmlHbi01a2g2Zw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and commodity dynamics:</strong> The rupee has strengthened to 94.79 against the dollar, supported by a softer greenback and easing US Treasury yields, even as crude oil prices remain elevated near $105 per barrel.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxOY2JZT0RrV3ptX0V5Nko0Z0JkY0NPVjFHUVhwb0JjaG9MZy1IbTJ4YkpWREU1eHJRS2plS0JIbndjZmk3TF9LaHEwRm1NRlFWcDVJcVo4bXpxNDJ2Mm9kd2ZXUnhjWDkwcW5oN3hiM1lSWVotUnhFc0hjY3FXeU9fSDBhWngzUXNKODlDT3ZVYUJwNzliSlIwM20xbkNLLVZBZm1XbVVycVNpV1l2VThPOXlUUDRpUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
